spec.name: sprint28_taker_imbalance_liquid_momentum
spec.hypothesis: A trailing 5-min taker buy/sell volume imbalance (z-score) in top-20 liquid large-caps + SPY/QQQ predicts short-horizon (15min) continuation, net of costs.
spec.power_argument: Basket of 20 liquid names, threshold-triggered entries (|z|>=2), expect >=300 trades over the sealed intraday test window at T1 costs; sized to detect a minimum edge of 15bps net (>2x round-trip cost) at t>2.
